Trinity S³AI

GF16 calculator: a number as 16 GoldenFloat bits and as ternary

Type a number and see its GF16 sign, exponent and mantissa bit by bit, the exact value it rounds to, the error, and the same number in balanced ternary.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • https://github.com/gHashTag/t27/blob/master/conformance/FORMAT-SPEC-001.json (formats.GF16, frozen_silicon_anchor)
  • https://t27.ai/t27/files/specs/numeric/gf16.t27 (layout constants, read by the page at run time)
  • https://github.com/gHashTag/t27/blob/master/conformance/vectors/gf16_conformance_v0.json (vectors the page checks itself against)
